sonnet.problem: The card says Jeroboam's rebellion 'starts back when' Solomon built the terraces and repaired the wall. Verse 27 only says 'this is the account of his rebellion' and then states the building work. It never says the building started the rebellion, so the card invents a connection the text leaves open.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: The card lists three gods (Ashtoreth, Chemosh, Milcom) and then says 'And they have not walked in His ways.' Grammatically 'they' points to the gods, but verse 33 means the people who forsook the LORD. The baker can't tell who 'they' is.
sonnet.rule: 'He,' 'she' and 'they' always point to someone the baker can tell.
